notes.title: Update Release Date and some Previews
notes.notes:
It has now been 5 weeks since the last update. For some, this is a very long time, as we usually release an update almost every Friday, but we are currently working on a somewhat larger update and therefore it is taking longer.

In this post we want to give you some more information about the update, announce the planned date of the update and show you some preview images.

Feedback from the community is very important to us and this is also the reason for this update.
Unfortunately, there is still some help missing in many parts of the game, more tutorials and many more hints to guide you as a player through the game mechanics. In addition, the entire interface in the game has been revised to bring a breath of fresh air into the game with a new design.

All the preview images we are showing now show before and after, but the content in the images may still change before the update.

It starts with the main menu, which has been redesigned and now has some life in the background.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/07e4a8c330aac467c39d95d09b8a7ae976e7bb8a.png

Especially when you wanted to edit your character, this was not always very nice to look at.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/88771a7f54921c52b11672b9af45ff7271eb1335.png

All other interfaces in the main menu have also been revised. And the pause menu is also like the main menu in terms of the overview, not like before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/db256e19dbe6899aafe3667e2dbdd5a9a2538be7.png

The help at the edge of the screen will be much more detailed in future. It will also be possible for the player to hide the help or collapse individual areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/24e42bc9fa78e1813a69844ae2d15421d724918c.png

In addition, the windows in the game have also been revised, here you can see an example.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/810a0a3b92af4d6958f0da42d0d77c1d06d7fa3a.png

We could show you a lot more of the various changes to the design, but we don't want to spoil everything. What is important for you now, when exactly will I get this.

The planned date of the upcoming update is 19.09.2025.

We are already looking forward to your feedback as soon as you have the update in your hands.

Otherwise, we wish you a quiet and relaxing weekend.



Roadmap https://trello.com/b/EC8Gd7iP/roadmap-public-early-access

Discord https://discord.gg/goldhunter

notes.title: Update Consume & Connect
notes.notes:
Soon the time will come. After a long time, fuel, electricity, water and gas consumption will finally come into play. But you'll have to be patient for a few more days.

Consumption will change a lot of things in the game. You can no longer simply start the engine or the machines, so you can, but it will cost you money.

In addition, some other features have been revised, such as the Physic Watch, which is responsible for turning the physics of items and vehicles on or off as required.

It has happened from time to time that items or vehicles have disappeared, but this should no longer happen with the revised version.

Of course, various bugs will also be fixed and perhaps there will be a surprise or two. 

The “Consume & Connect” update is planned for April 2025.

Gold Hunter is currently still on offer for around 24 hours, so grab it now so that you can enjoy the game, the new update and many other updates.

So, that's all for now. Here are some preview images of the update.

notes.title: Version 0.64 *Experimental*
notes.notes:
Version 0.64 Alpha has been released on the Experimental Branch.

The most important change is the switch from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5.
Everyone must start a new savegame and please note that this is an experimental version.

So that you don't have to wait any longer, we'll let you be part of it.

You can switch to the "Experimental" beta in Steam as follows.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/4fb10cc66ce5713fee774d2968755e2363d10896.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/5fec2fee37ff7ff0d209956571c458319aa6af8e.png

Please note, if you have played Gold Hunter before, to deactivate the Steam Cloud for Gold Hunter once and delete all savegames locally.

Here is the path to the savegames, simply enter it in the browser line of your desktop.

%userprofile%\AppData\Local\GoldHunter\Saved\SaveGames

Please note that many things are still deactivated or unfinished.
These will be added bit by bit with regular updates.

Otherwise we look forward to your bug reports, you can create them directly in the game with "F8".

The team wishes you all a nice weekend and happy holidays.

notes.title: Version 0.619 Alpha *Experimental*
notes.notes:
Info

■ Our voxel in the game is completely reworked. Every claim will be reset.

■ Activated bugreport system again

This update includes major changes regarding voxels and multiplayer.
As this is still a very early phase, the update will be released on the Beta Branch "Experimental" in Steam.
This way, every player can decide whether they want to test this already or rather wait a little longer until the update is included in the standard.

To switch to the "Experimental" branch, you simply have to right-click on Gold Hunter in your game library, select the menu item "Settings" and log in to "Betas" for "Experimental". You can then download this version directly. 
Please note that this will reset every claim.

You can switch back at any time if you change your mind by logging out of "Experimental" under "Betas". This will automatically download the previous version again.

notes.title: Update in progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we know that you are all eagerly awaiting the first major update after Early Access, especially those of you who are used to our regular updates. That's why we wanted to let you know that we've been working hard on this major update since Early Access to fix the multiplayer, vehicle and voxel issues. 

However, in order to be able to bring you a stable update, it still needs one or two fixes and fine-tuning, so we will inform you as soon as we can say for sure that the update is ready. Until then, we would like to ask you for a little patience, even if it is difficult.

notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
We have some news for you!

Finally we can give you a date for the Early Access on Steam:
Gold Hunter will be released on Steam on Friday, May 13th, 2022 at 6pm UTC.
At the same time we will stream the Early Access on Twitch - so you can be there live.

As you know, the playtest is currently running on Steam, which allows you to test the game for free.

The planned end of the playtest was originally May 1st 9.59pm UTC. 
However, due to the delays in reworking the multiplayer, we have decided to extend the playtest until May 6, 9.59pm UTC, so that you can still test it extensively.

We hope that with this announcement we can answer your open questions about the release.

notes.title: Release Information
notes.notes:
Soon it is time, only a short time left until the first demo release.
Many hours, sleepless nights and a lot of energy were invested to make this possible. 
And especially in the last days we have worked hard to get ready in time for the demo release.

Apparently one of our plugins was updated in one of the last updates and now causes a problem.
The whole thing affects multiplayer and causes that not every player can get on the server and cannot be created as a character. Unfortunately, this was discovered too late by us, and therefore we are now in this situation. Our highest priority is that we do not provide you with a half-finished demo, but that both the single and the whole game are available for download. Especially that the multiplayer mode works, which you are eagerly waiting for.

We've been working on the problem for a few days now and have had many team meetings, but it hasn't led to the desired result. We know, this news comes unfortunately very late, but we wanted to keep the release day on Friday. We also didn't want to offer you garbage as a demo. We want you to have the possibility to get to know the game properly and not permanently annoyed because something doesn't work. Currently we can tell you that we need a few more days to solve the problem and give you the desired gaming fun. 

We are already busy with troubleshooting and will inform you as soon as we have new news and can publish the demo. We can understand your disappointment and your displeasure very well, because we feel the same way because we couldn't keep the deadline. We were also looking forward to sharing the demo with you tomorrow and your feedback on it.

But we won't give up right now, and to make active use of the time, we will also cancel the stream this Friday, because we really need every spare minute to solve the problem and to make the game fun for you in a demo that we would also like to see for ourselves.
